transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… work sent me. At the warehouse I’ve been doing stuff they say is weird. Like standing there with my arms up by the forklift, copying the beeps or the hand signals… moving boxes around in little patterns even when people tell me to stop.
Do you feel like you have to do these things, like moving boxes in patterns or copying the beeps?

I don’t know if “have to” is the right way to say it. I just… end up doing it. Like the boxes feel like they should go a certain way, or I catch myself copying the forklift beeps or the hand signals. People yell, but it’s hard to stop right then.
Do you feel anxious when you're told to stop doing these things, like moving the boxes in patterns?
I don’t know. Not really anxious, maybe… I just don’t like being interrupted. It feels off, and then people are staring, so I kind of shut down.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, even when you try to think about something else?
Not really… I mean, I think about stuff, but I don’t know if it’s like repeating. I haven’t noticed it like that.
Do you feel like these behaviors, such as moving boxes in patterns, are aimed at preventing something bad from happening?
I don’t think so. I’m not… doing it to stop something bad, at least not that I can tell. It just feels like that’s how it goes, and then I’m already doing it.
Do you have any thoughts that you try to ignore or suppress, but they keep coming back to you?
I don’t think so. I mean… thoughts come and go, but I’m not really trying to push them away like that. I haven’t noticed anything that keeps coming back.
Do you have any thoughts that feel like they are your own, but also feel intrusive or unwanted?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of them that way… like intrusive or whatever. Sometimes thoughts are there, but I don’t know if I’d call them unwanted.
Do you feel like you're doing these behaviors to make yourself feel just right or to get a certain feeling?
I don’t know. Not really like… getting a certain feeling. I just kind of do it, and it feels off if I don’t, maybe. Hard to explain.
Do you feel like things need to be symmetrical or just so, when you're doing these behaviors like moving boxes in patterns?

Not really symmetrical, no. I just… move the boxes into little patterns sometimes. Or I’ll stop by the forklift and do the beeps or the hand signals back. People get mad and tell me to stop, but it’s not like I’m trying to make it perfect.
Do you feel like your behaviors at work are causing problems for you in other areas of your life?

Yeah… I guess it is. They don’t let me do the forklift stuff anymore, and I’m behind in my classes. I stopped going to the church food bank too. People say they can’t really count on me, or that it’s not safe when I’m around.
Do you ever feel like you're repeating certain actions over and over?

Yeah… I guess so. At work I’ll keep doing the same stuff, like freezing by the forklift with my arms up, or copying the beeps and the hand signals. Sometimes I move boxes into these little patterns again and again, even when people are yelling at me to stop.
Do you have any thoughts that keep coming back to you, even when you're not trying to think about them?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I mean, I think about work stuff sometimes, but I haven’t noticed, like, one thought that keeps coming back over and over.
Do you feel like the way you arrange things, like the boxes, has to be exactly a certain way?
I don’t know if it has to be exact. I just… end up moving the boxes into these little patterns, and I keep doing it even when people tell me to stop. It feels hard to just leave it alone.
Do you think that something bad would happen if you didn't do these behaviors, like moving the boxes in patterns?

I don’t really think it’s like… something bad will happen. I just get stuck doing it. Like with the boxes, or standing there by the forklift with my arms up, copying the sounds or signals. People yell, but I still keep going sometimes.
Do you feel like the things you do, such as moving boxes, have to be done in a very specific way?

Not really exact, no. It’s more like… I just start doing it. The boxes end up in these weird little patterns, or I freeze by the forklift with my arms up and copy the beeps and signals. Even when people yell at me to stop, I kind of… keep doing it.
Do you feel like the things you do have to be done in a specific order or sequence?

Not really a sequence. I just… get stuck doing stuff, like at the warehouse. Freezing by the forklift with my arms up, copying the beeps or signals, or putting boxes in odd little patterns. People yell at me to stop, but I don’t always stop.
Do you feel like the things you do, such as moving boxes, have to be symmetrical or perfect in some way?

No… not symmetrical or perfect. It’s just… I get stuck doing it. Like the boxes end up in strange little patterns, or I freeze by the forklift with my arms up and copy the beeps and signals. Even if people yell, sometimes I don’t stop.
Do you feel like you are trying to relieve anxiety or discomfort when you do these repetitive behaviors?
I don’t really know. I’m not… doing it to calm down, I don’t think. It just kind of happens, and then I notice I’m still doing it.
Do you have unwanted thoughts that keep coming back to you?
I don’t know… not really like that. I mean, thoughts come and go, but I haven’t noticed one that keeps coming back over and over.
Do you have thoughts that you think are unreasonable or excessive, but you can't stop thinking about them?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of them as unreasonable or excessive… I just haven’t noticed anything like that getting stuck in my head.
